in_sanskrit.name: अप्रमेय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अनरक्तम् (Anraktam) - अपि (api) रक्तम् (raktaM) अस्ति न निवेशयितुम् (nasti niveShayitum) - not desiring wealth, wealthless

in_hindi.name: अप्रमेय
in_hindi.long_meaning: अपि (api) रक्तम (raktaM) नहीं है (nahaī̃) - not having wealth

in_tamil.name: அப்ரமேய
in_tamil.long_meaning: பிறப்பும் (piṟappum) - அவர்களுக்கே (avarkaḷukkē) அறியாது (ariyādu) - undeserving, not being deserving to them

in_telugu.name: ఆప్రమేయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: అపి (api) రక్టమే (rakTame) అయిప్పేదు (ayippēdu) - not having wealth

in_marathi.name: Aprameya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aprameya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aprameya is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'apra' meaning 'unmeasurable' and 'meya' meaning 'great'. It is a name given to one who is considered to be incomparable or unmeasurable in terms of strength, wisdom, or power.
